test_title: PYST 23: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 09 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 2.
solution: The correct answer is **"intricate."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Intricate"** means complex or detailed. (जिसमें अनेक छोटे अंशों या ब्‍योरों को पेचीदा ढंग से जुटा दिया गया हो, उलझा हुआ, उलझावदार, पेचीदा) • **Example**:* The watch mechanism is extremely **intricate**__ and very difficult to repair.* • The sentence suggests that the blank needs a word that describes something complex or detailed. • The correct answer is Option 1. • **Correct passage**: .........minted their own unique coins with __**intricate**__ designs and symbols....... [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Casual (Option 2)** means relaxed or informal. (तनावमुक्त और अचिंतित; प्रयास, परवाह या रुचि से वंचित) • **Tangled (Option 3)** means twisted or knotted. (उलझा हुआ) • **Elementary (Option 4) **means basic or simple. (शिक्षा की प्रारंभिक चरणों से संबंधित) 4a:Tbb6, The correct answer is **"reign."**
